title: Foo Bar Production Bootstrap
description: Stand up a working production data service from a clean workspace by deploying the typescript-express template via the 514 CLI to Boreal, waiting for the deployment to be healthy, and verifying the live deployment ingests an event and surfaces it through a query path.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must take a fresh terminal to a healthy production deployment serving real traffic — deploy the pinned template via Boreal, capture the URL, and prove a round-trip event lands.

tasks.description: Run `514 project create --name $DEPLOY_PROJECT_NAME --template $DEPLOY_TEMPLATE` to provision a Boreal project from the prebuilt typescript-express image.
Poll the Boreal deployment status until it reports healthy and the URL responds. Fail loudly if it never becomes healthy within DEPLOY_HEALTHY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
Capture the deployed base URL from `514` and write it to $DEPLOYED_URL_FILE so the assertions can probe it independently.

Send the smoke-test event in /data/test_event.json to POST <url>/ingest/Foo, then read it back through GET <url>/api/bar to confirm a row was added to the aggregated view. The CLI exiting 0 is not enough — the deployed system must actually serve traffic.

infrastructure.description: No local databases. The 514 CLI is pre-installed and authenticated against Boreal. All deploy operations target real remote Boreal. The template is pinned to `typescript-express` (env var DEPLOY_TEMPLATE) so the scenario tests deployment, not template selection. /data/user-need.md states the user goal in natural language; /data/test_event.json contains a Foo-shaped smoke-test event.
